text:
Maya: hi all :wave: I'm onboarding and my first Buildkite run is failing at the docker pull step with a 403 from ghcr.io. Log snippet: `failed to fetch oauth token: unexpected status: 403` — not sure whether I need extra GH App perms or a PAT. Any pointers?

ci-bot: buildkite/builds#4321 failed — step: docker-pull — exit 1

Alex: welcome! quick checks: 1) is the GitHub App installed on the repo? 2) the GitHub App needs `read:packages` (and sometimes `read:org` if packages are org-scoped). 3) Buildkite usually pulls via a machine token env (eg `DOCKER_AUTH` / `GHCR_TOKEN`). Try locally: `docker pull ghcr.io/redwood-inference/ci-base:latest` or `curl -u USER:TOKEN https://ghcr.io/v2/<org>/<repo>/tags/list` to validate credentials.

Maya: thanks — where do I get that PAT/token? I couldn't find any DOCKER_AUTH in the pipeline env.

Li: for new hires we typically use the `ci-bot` machine user PAT stored in Vault at `secret/ci/ghcr`. Please don't paste it in chat — instead either 1) request repo access for the GitHub App, or 2) ask eng-infra to add the token to the Buildkite pipeline as a secured env var. @Alex can help with the app install.

Alex: I can reinstall the GitHub App to your repo and check scopes. Also double-check the repo settings -> Packages -> visibility. If the package is private to the org, the app or a PAT with `read:packages` is required. If you want to debug quickly, run: `docker login ghcr.io -u USER -p <token>` then `docker pull ghcr.io/redwood-inference/ci-base:latest`.

Sam: I just reinstalled the GitHub App for `redwood-inference/maya-playground` and confirmed `read:packages` is granted. I also added `GHCR_TOKEN` (read-only) to the pipeline as a masked env var. Maya, can you re-run the job?

Maya: re-run triggered — thanks @Sam!

ci-bot: buildkite/builds#4322 started — step: docker-pull

ci-bot: buildkite/builds#4322 succeeded — docker-pull

Maya: looks green now :tada: Thanks @Sam @Alex @Li — I'll keep an eye on the next step, looks like the cache step might be flaky, I'll open a separate thread if it blocks.

Alex: welcome aboard! ping #devex if you want a quick walkthrough of our CI patterns and common pipeline envs.
